notes.title: Cave Crawler(: A Retro Exploration Adventure) Steam Reveal
notes.notes:
Hello, TheCasualWendigo here. Exciting to actually get my game on Steam, and I wanted to celebrate. While the game will not be releasing for a [i]while[/i], it is my job as the creator to let you know that I am doing something to further development. So, here is an exclusive sneak peek at what I'm working on. Please note that this is subject to change, especially as this was not optimized for the actual game engine.
